# Task Requirements Quality Checklist: One-off Tasks

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, and scenario coverage of the approved task requirements and design contracts before task decomposition.
**Created**: 2026-11-25
**Feature**: [One-off tasks and assignment defaults](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by `$speckit-checklist` from the feature context.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only after the reviewer determines that the criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` records requirements quality, not completed implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the included task operations and excluded lifecycle, checklist, recurrence, shared responsibility, and browser work explicitly bounded? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK002 Are the task's required and optional attributes, initial state, and initial version specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003; Contract §Create; Data model §Transitions and invariants]
- [x] CHK003 Are the editable fields, immutable fields, and version requirements explicitly identified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004; Contract §Read and edit]
- [x] CHK004 Are the household access, assignee eligibility, and responsibility context requirements specified at the application boundary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005–006; Module contracts]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are omitted assignment and explicit unassignment distinguished for standalone and responsibility-linked creation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001–002; Contract §Create]
- [x] CHK006 Are omitted fields, explicit nulls, and clearing representations specified for every editable field? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004; Contract §Read and edit]
- [x] CHK007 Are accepted priority values and the omitted creation default unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003; Clarifications]
- [x] CHK008 Are the accepted deadline variants, household zone interpretation, precision, and invalid local-time choices defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007–008; Contract §Deadline input]
- [x] CHK009 Are validation, state conflict, stale version, inaccessible resource, and invalid assignee outcomes differentiated without revealing foreign existence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005; Contract §Error and compatibility rules]

## Consistency and Traceability

- [x] CHK010 Are M0 individual ownership defaults consistent across the issue, spec, API contract, and exclusion of M1 shared defaults? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002 and §Assumptions; Contract §Create]
- [x] CHK011 Are status and overdue requirements consistent with D01, D04, and the exclusion of terminal transitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, FR-007; Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK012 Are lock ordering, application authorization, and cross-module contract preconditions consistent across the plan, module contracts, and data model? [Consistency, Plan §Design and sequencing; Module contracts; Data model §Transitions and invariants]
- [x] CHK013 Are the selected migration behavior and public API compatibility explicitly described and consistent across the approved plan and supporting contracts? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check; Data model §Migration; Contract §Error and compatibility rules]

## Acceptance Criteria and Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Can title-only, explicit assignment, default ownership, and ownership-transfer scenarios each be objectively evaluated from the stated outcomes? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Stories 1–2; SC-001, SC-004]
- [x] CHK015 Are absent, foreign, inactive, paused, archived, and unauthenticated reference scenarios and their non-disclosure expectations specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005–006; Contract §Error and compatibility rules]
- [x] CHK016 Are stale, invalid, terminal, and successful edit scenarios specified with outcomes for the task version and related changes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004; Data model §Transitions and invariants]
- [x] CHK017 Are concurrent ownership, membership, and task edits described with valid serialized outcomes and no partial committed state? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases; Plan §Verification and AC mapping]
- [x] CHK018 Are date-only and instant boundary, daylight-saving gap and overlap, no-deadline, and terminal cases defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007–008; Contract §Deadline input]

## Recovery, Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK019 Are populated legacy task rows, fresh/empty upgrade paths, and data-preserving migration failure requirements specified? [Recovery, Data model §Migration; Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK020 Are atomicity and rollback requirements specified for failed creates, edits, and associated edit facts? [Recovery, Spec §FR-005; Contract §Read and edit; Data model §Atomic edit fact]
- [x] CHK021 Are HO-12 ownership/lifecycle and HO-81 deadline foundations identified as dependencies, and is reuse of their semantics stated? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements for historical assignments after membership inactivity distinguished from eligibility for a new assignment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005–006; Contract §Task view; Data model §Task]
- [x] CHK023 Are the accepted requirements and proposed validation bounds, wire representation, migration tradeoff, and owner approvals traceable to their governing artifacts? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Constitution Check; Contract §Create]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after a reviewer confirms each requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation is still needed.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
